purpose: Descriptive confounding audit for the F4 low-score corridor; no model retraining and no causal claim.

river_covariate.distance_definition: Euclidean distance in metres from each 100 m grid-cell centre to the union of returned Rio Grande flowline geometries

land_cover_covariate.source: USGS/MRLC NLCD 2021 Land Cover Science Products
land_cover_covariate.product: NLCD 2021 land cover, CONUS, 30 m categorical raster
land_cover_covariate.resampling: nearest-neighbour to the fixed 100 m target grid
land_cover_covariate.summary: retain the native class code and report class frequencies; no one-hot feature enters the trained models
land_cover_covariate.download_control: download only after source metadata and archive hash are recorded

analysis.scope: valid labelled pixels in F1-F4; primary descriptive emphasis F4
outputs: land-cover class prevalence by label and fold
score distributions by distance bin and land-cover class
analysis.primary_models: frozen V4.2 probability arrays; no retraining
prohibited_claims: NLCD class is a geological mechanism
